mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.kb_id, c.title, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.created_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS created_at FROM conversation c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
SELECT c.id, c.kb_id, c.title, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.created_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS created_at FROM conversation c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.kb_id, kb.name AS kb_name, c.title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id) AS message_count, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.deleted_at) * 1000 AS UNSIGNED) AS deleted_at FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = c.kb_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 1 ORDER BY c.deleted_at DESC
SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET deleted = 0, deleted_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
